lead: Targeted support for fats and bile. Ox bile and artichoke help your body break down fats and keep bile flowing, while DigeZyme enzymes and soothing botanicals support comfortable digestion — built for gallbladder and liver function.

science.title: Why bile matters for digestion
science.text: Bile is how your body breaks down and absorbs fats — and when it's sluggish, heavy meals sit uncomfortably. We pair ox bile (standardized to 40% cholic acid) with artichoke to support bile flow, DigeZyme enzymes to break food down, and soothing botanicals — targeted support for your gallbladder, liver and digestion.

facts.side_title: A complex, not a single herb
facts.side_text: 500 mg artichoke, a 300 mg Ayurvedic blend (Terminalia chebula, Sphaeranthus indicus), 125 mg ox bile (40% cholic acid), 50 mg DigeZyme enzymes and 40 mg slippery elm — in a gelatin capsule. Made in the USA — 60 capsules.
facts.warning: Contains ox bile (animal-derived). Pregnant or nursing women, children under 18, and anyone with a gallbladder, liver or other medical condition should consult a physician before use. Do not exceed the recommended dose.

items.q: What is ox bile and why take it?
items.a: Ox bile provides bile salts that help your body break down and absorb dietary fats. It's especially useful if your gallbladder has been removed or your own bile runs low.
No — it contains ox bile (animal-derived) and a gelatin capsule, so it isn't vegetarian or vegan.
With meals, ideally your largest or fattiest meal of the day, so the bile and enzymes are there when you eat.
People who feel heavy or uncomfortable after fatty meals, or who want to support gallbladder, liver and fat digestion.
If you're pregnant, nursing, under 18, or have a gallbladder, liver or other medical condition, consult a physician before use.
